PIXHAKU

Level 1
♥♥♥ 0/0

How To Play

Describe the game

A Shikaku puzzle that restores a hidden picture. Drag to draw rectangles: each one holds exactly one number and covers that many cells. Rectangles can't overlap. Fill the board to reveal the artwork.

What to try

  • Draw a wrong rectangle and you lose 1 ♥. Lose all 3 to see the fail screen.
  • Tap and release without dragging: it cancels with no penalty.
  • Find the ? clue: its size is hidden.
  • Use Hint 3 times, then watch an ad for more.

Picture revealed!

Out of hearts!
